title: State inspection blocked for five months, then hasty return home
place_text: Baker Victory Services / Springville, New York

tellings.quote: apparently for 5 months, the record something goes, uh, Baker Victory Services was refusing access to the state to come in and inspect me,

plain: For five months in 2010, a children's services organisation called Baker Victory Services, in Springville, New York, is said to have refused to let state officials come in and inspect a boy in its care, before he was hastily sent home. That boy was Jordan Jose, who says he was taken into a secret UFO programme as a child, and he tells this to Jesse Michels from his own life. He says the record shows the five-month refusal, and he mentions the journalist Ross Coulthart in telling it. If true, it would mean someone was keeping him out of the authorities' sight.
